method: Overlap unchanged official Ty CLI diagnostics with plugin flow. The native view includes minimal partial provider overlays with exact patched declarations and copied ancestor initializers, plus the exact import preflight. Reuse requires the same final projections, selected paths, import probes, configuration and strongly identified observed source/directory revisions. Inferred-type requests, changed inputs or native failures retain the established checker path. No original source or provider is written.

Avoid redundant file metadata and stream-position queries while reading source snapshots; preserve UTF-8, growth and short-read behavior.
Fuse Django model scope and alias indexes and cache scope resolution within one request.
